threshold_decision.requirement: strictly greater than 80% of distinct eligible records
threshold_decision.method: one-sided 95% Bonferroni normal lower bounds over seven prespecified cutoffs; block clustering/FPC; conservative unknown-fee membership; asymptotic, not a full census guarantee
threshold_decision.bootstrap_screen: Require both one-sided seven-cutoff adjusted normal and rescaled block-bootstrap lower bounds strictly above 80%; asymptotic sensitivity only.

ci_limitations: HT totals; block-cluster ratio linearization with stratum FPC; pointwise normal 95% except explicit seven-cutoff Bonferroni selection. Asymptotic, not formal guarantees. Sparse/extreme tails and heavy block counts can have poor coverage. Zero-observed tails unresolved.
packing_limitations: Additive payload/envelope/fragment estimates, not a full-chain packing replay. packing_bounds evaluates per-record fee-length possibilities including the nonmonotone inline jump. No measured native latency/RSS.
